description: How long LaunchTrace keeps each class of data before `python -m src.pipeline retention --apply` anonymises, clears or deletes it. Enforced by src/retention.py; documented in docs/DATA_RETENTION.md and docs/DATA_MAP.md. Nothing here changes a score.
_comment: EVERY PERIOD BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER PENDING OWNER DECISION. The defaults are the bracketed values in docs/DATA_RETENTION.md (see HUMAN_ACTIONS.md, 'Phase 2 — compliance'). A period may be given in 'months' or 'days' (not both). Set 'enabled' to false to stop a class being touched at all. The suppression lists (suppression_rules, prospect_suppressions), customers within a subscription, customer_preferences, journals metadata, brands, observations and stage_changes are never touched by retention, whatever this file says.

trademark_records_individual_names.description: Sets applicant_name to NULL on records whose applicant is not displayable as a company under config/privacy.json (no legal form such as Ltd/PLC/LLP, or a sole-trader pattern such as 'trading as') (a likely private individual). The record itself, and corporate applicants' names, are kept. Trade-off (DECISIONS.md D-405): an individual whose earlier filing is older than this period is no longer recognised as a repeat filer by the 'first trade mark for this applicant' signal.

opportunities_individual_names.description: Sets applicant_name to NULL where applicant_type is natural_person, or the applicant is not displayable as a company under config/privacy.json (no legal form such as Ltd/PLC/LLP, or a sole-trader pattern such as 'trading as'). Scores, bands and company fields are kept.

company_matches_individual_names.description: Where the applicant is not displayable as a company under config/privacy.json (no legal form such as Ltd/PLC/LLP, or a sole-trader pattern such as 'trading as'): sets applicant_name and error to NULL and empties match_evidence (both can quote the name). Company fields and the match result are kept.

web_enrichment.age_from: enriched_at (rows never enriched are left alone)
web_enrichment.description: Web evidence goes stale; old rows are deleted rather than trusted.

pipeline_runs.description: Operational run records (counts, warnings). The journals table, which prevents duplicate processing, is never touched.

errors.description: Operational error log; messages can quote record details.

deliveries.description: Delivery log (holds recipient email addresses). Only old rows; recent ones are the double-send guard.

sample_requests.age_from: the later of created_at and sent_at
sample_requests.description: Inbound sample requests (work email, contact name).

prospect_contacts.age_from: the latest dated interaction on the row (email, sample, offer, conversion, follow-up), else date_added, else created_at
prospect_contacts.description: Clears the personal fields of prospects with no interaction in the period. The row stays (a deleted row is a row that gets re-added) and prospect_suppressions is never touched. Prospects linked to a customer whose subscription is not cancelled are skipped.

lead_feedback_notes.description: Clears the free-text note; the feedback state (evidence for tuning) is kept.

webhook_events.description: Stripe webhook idempotency records and payment audit trail.
